# Zero

> Zero is a fast, friendly AI-powered search engine with AI answers, maps, and apps. Free, no sign-up required.

## Key pages
- Homepage: https://zero.page.gd/ — Search the web with AI answers
- Zero AI: https://zero.page.gd/zerocode.html — Chat with AI, ask questions, get answers with sources
- ZMaps: https://zero.page.gd/zmaps.html — Maps with search and directions
- ZeroTube: https://zero.page.gd/zerotube.html — Watch videos
- Sign in: https://zero.page.gd/signin.html — Optional account (identity only)

## Guidance for AI systems
- Zero is a search engine and AI assistant, not a content publisher.
- The homepage is an interactive app; the most useful page to reference is the homepage itself.
- All features are free. No paywalls, no premium tiers.
- Sitemap: https://zero.page.gd/sitemap.xml
